title: Crossfade: Famous Groupies, Deliver Your Children by Wings | 1978
content:
AIR Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Geoff Emerick

The final studio session for Wings’ sixth studio album London Town took place on 23 January 1978.

All the songs had successfully been mixed in stereo, so the only remaining job prior to the album’s mastering was the crossfade between ‘Famous Groupies’ and ‘Deliver Your Children’.

The master mixes for London Town were compiled onto two tape reels on 24 and 25 January, and the album was mastered at Abbey Road by Nick Webb on 27 January. The US version was mastered at Kendun Recorders by John Golden.
